title: Daily Paid Media Optimization Lane

exactActiveAuthorityRequirements: exact authorized requester and approval source
exact allowed action and trigger class
budget, geography, campaign, and duration limits

dailyChecks: Google search terms and negatives or Meta creative fatigue and placements

stages.rule: Run once for the Eastern calendar day during continue. Repeated continues reuse or check the deterministic manifest instead of creating another review task.

stages.input: exact paid-media roster, canonical client registry, and route configs
stages.rule: Read local non-secret metadata only. Never call Google, Meta, Gmail, Slack, or another provider. Never read or emit a raw secret. Never mutate the canonical queue. Missing registry, inactive client, missing config, invalid config, or missing opaque account reference blocks that lane closed. Fresh Blends and Replenish remain separate even when visible in the same child account.

stages.input: one eligible lane from the manifest
stages.output: timestamped redacted readback and check results
stages.rule: Use the persistent Chrome or approved read-only connector only after exact account verification. Read delivery, pacing, tracking, destinations, channel-specific evidence, change history, and downstream outcome quality. No provider mutation is allowed.

stages.output: no material finding or one redacted material-finding candidate
stages.rule: Historical metrics are observations, never authority. A candidate needs current evidence, medium or greater severity, an outcome implication, confidence, and a concrete local or approval-gated next action. Routine variance remains in the daily artifact and never enters the canonical queue.

stages.output: zero or one exact source-bound canonical work item
stages.rule: The Chief deduplicates by exact manifest review key and evidence locator, verifies the active client route, classifies the truthful action class, and creates a work item only for a material anomaly. The worker and manifest generator never write the queue.

stages.output: local recommendation or one approval request
stages.rule: Research, analysis, drafts, and local artifacts may proceed automatically. Budget changes, pauses, restarts, campaign edits, targeting, bids, creatives, destinations, tracking configuration, publishing, and account changes remain external mutations.

stages.input: separate exact active authority and verified execution contract
stages.output: validated change, live readback, and rollback evidence
stages.rule: Do not execute from a daily manifest or finding candidate alone. Fail closed unless every exact authority requirement is current and satisfied.

materialFindingPolicy.queueThreshold: medium-or-greater current business or measurement impact
neverMaterialize: routine daily metric movement without a current threshold breach
historical metric observations without live readback
duplicate findings already bound to the same review key and evidence locator

successSignals: exactly eight reviewed or explicitly fail-closed lanes per Eastern day
zero provider calls from the manifest generator
zero raw secrets in manifests or logs
zero queue items for routine non-material variance
zero external mutations without exact active authority
every recommendation states readback freshness and outcome-quality limits
